non-alcoholic beverages market growth forecast 2026 2027 demand outlook
Coca-Cola global market share pricing trend 2026 volume elasticity

findings.claim: Q3 2026 全球單位箱量 +5%（印度、中國、墨西哥、巴西領軍），price/mix +1%，並在整體 NARTD 飲料取得價值市佔提升
findings.excerpt: Unit case volume grew 5%, led by India, China, Mexico and Brazil. Price/mix grew 1%, primarily driven by pricing actions in the marketplace, partially offset by unfavorable mix. The company gained value share in total nonalcoholic ready-to-drink (“NARTD”) beverages.

findings.claim: 北美 Q3 單位箱量持平：Trademark Coca-Cola 成長被水、運動飲料、咖啡茶下滑抵銷
findings.excerpt: Unit case volume was even, as growth in Trademark Coca-Cola was offset by a decline in water, sports, coffee and tea.

findings.claim: 拉美 Q3 量 +6%、price/mix +7%（定價與有利組合）；亞太量 +6% 但 price/mix -2%（定價被不利組合抵銷）
findings.excerpt: Price/mix grew 7%, primarily driven by pricing actions in the marketplace and favorable mix.

findings.claim: 亞太 Q3 price/mix 下滑 2%
findings.excerpt: Price/mix declined 2%, as pricing actions in the marketplace were more than offset by unfavorable mix.

findings.claim: 全年 2026 有機營收指引上調為至少 5%（前為約 5%）
Q2 2026 EMEA 價值市佔下滑（法國、英國流失大於奈及利亞、摩洛哥增益）

end_markets.note: 非酒精飲料 TAM：第三方研究機構（Business Research Co、IMARC、Lucintel）預測約 4–5% 年增，但為付費研究摘要、口徑差異大，未取得可逐字原文，不列 finding。

clues.claim: 非酒精飲料市場 2026 年約 +4.8%（614.72B→644.11B 美元，TBRC）
